WITH combined_data AS (
    SELECT 
        ws_item_sk item_sk,
        d_date,
        sum(ws_sales_price) AS web_cume_sales,
        sum(ss_sales_price) AS store_cume_sales
    FROM 
        web_sales ws
    JOIN 
        store_sales ss ON ws_item_sk = ss_item_sk AND d_date = ss_sold_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_month_seq BETWEEN 1212 AND 1212+11
    GROUP BY item_sk, d_date
) 
SELECT 
    item_sk,
    d_date,
    web_cume_sales,
    store_cume_sales
FROM 
    combined_data
WHERE 
    d_date IN (SELECT d_date FROM combined_data)
ORDER BY 
    item_sk, d_date DESC
LIMIT 100
